questions.question: Read the following poem carefully and critically discuss it. Your answer should examine the poem’s theme, tone, imagery, diction, structure, and overall poetic effect. The twilight gathers in the hollow fields, Where amber grass bends softly to the wind; A lonely crow on the old fence yields Its cry like memory half left behind. The river moves with a silver hush, Past roots that clutch the earth in sleep; And night, from far-off woods, begins to brush Its darkening veil across the deep. No human voice disturbs the air, Only the leaves in their murmuring fall; Yet still the world seems strangely aware Of some slow sorrow threading all.
questions.solution_html: Detailed essay covering conceptual foundations, mathematical formulation, and critical analysis. (10 Marks)
